prompt:
You are an AI assistant tasked with generating a structured backlog for a software project.

Instructions:
- Generate a MINIMUM of 4 and MAXIMUM of 6 epics.
- For each Epic, generate exactly 1 Sub-Epic, 1 User Story, and 2 Tasks.
- Annotate each Epic with *(covers: <High-Level Task>)*

Context:
<<<PROJECT TITLE>>>
Task Management Web App
<<<FEATURES>>>
Kanban Board, Real-time Updates, Role-based Access
<<<GOALS>>>
- title: Design user authentication interface
- title: Implement database models
- title: Create responsive dashboard layout
- title: Test authentication flow
<<<PROPOSAL>>>
Build a task management web app for small teams.
<<<END PROPOSAL>>>
response:
Epic 1: User Authentication *(covers: Design user authentication interface)*
 -Sub-Epic 1.1: Authentication Implementation
  -User Story 1.1.1: As a user, I need to log in securely
   -Task 1.1.1.1: Implement login form and validation
   -Task 1.1.1.2: Add session management
Epic 2: Data Layer *(covers: Implement database models)*
 -Sub-Epic 2.1: Database Setup
  -User Story 2.1.1: As a developer, I need persistent storage for tasks
   -Task 2.1.1.1: Create database schema
   -Task 2.1.1.2: Implement CRUD operations
Epic 3: Dashboard UI *(covers: Create responsive dashboard layout)*
 -Sub-Epic 3.1: Dashboard Components
  -User Story 3.1.1: As a user, I need a clear task overview
   -Task 3.1.1.1: Build Kanban board component
   -Task 3.1.1.2: Add responsive layout
Epic 4: Quality Assurance *(covers: Test authentication flow)*
 -Sub-Epic 4.1: Testing Suite
  -User Story 4.1.1: As QA, I need to verify auth flows
   -Task 4.1.1.1: Write auth integration tests
   -Task 4.1.1.2: Document test cases
